<script id="archium-4-6-2-legal-js">(function(){
'use strict';
const gate=document.getElementById('archium-legal-notice');
const confirm=document.getElementById('archium-legal-continue');
if(!gate||!confirm)return;
function proceed(){
  if(window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_AFTER_ENTRY_DONE)return;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_AFTER_ENTRY_DONE=true;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_PENDING_ENTRY=false;
  const next=window.ARCHIUM_GUIDE_AFTER_NOTICE;
  if(typeof next==='function'){
    window.ARCHIUM_GUIDE_AFTER_NOTICE=null;
    next();
    return;
  }
  const chooser=document.getElementById('guide-choice43');
  if(chooser && !chooser.hidden)return;
  const entry=document.getElementById('voron-entry');
  if(entry && !entry.hidden)return;
  const menu=document.getElementById('voron-menu-open');
  if(menu)menu.click();
}
window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_FINALIZE=proceed;
function show(){
  if(window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_DISMISSED)return;
  window.ARCHIUM_LEGAL_NOTICE_ACTIVE=true;
  gate.hidden=false;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('archium-legal-open');
  window.requestAnimationFrame(()=>{try{confirm.focus({preventScroll:true})}catch(e){}});
}
// Clicking before the heavy application loaded must remain effective.
if(window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_PENDING_ENTRY)proceed();
else show();
gate.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(gate.hidden)return;
  if(e.key==='Escape'||e.key==='Tab'){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    confirm.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
});
window.addEventListener('pageshow',function(e){
  if(!e.persisted)return;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_DISMISSED=false;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_AFTER_ENTRY_DONE=false;
  window.ARCHIUM_NOTICE_PENDING_ENTRY=false;
  show();
});
})();</script>
